messages:
Alex: quick sync on MerchantCo POC — they want streaming SDK + function calls, EU-only data, customer KMS, and a pricing estimate for a dedicated pool. any red flags?
Priya: noted. EU-only implies Private or Dedicated with VPC peering. Legal will insist on KMS key-handling diagrams.
Marco: streaming SDK tip: use the websocket client with ephemeral creds for live sessions to avoid long-lived keys. sample init:
```
ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-7b', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${EPHEMERAL_TOKEN}`, 'X-Region': 'eu-central-1' }
})
```
Tanner: they plan to use structured output for transaction parsing. suggest function-calling fallback if schema parsing fails. schema sample: `{"tx_id": string, "amount": number, "currency": string}`.
SE-Ben: quantization can cut cost ~2-3x, but we should run a targeted eval on their prompt set. i'll request sample prompts + expected match threshold.
Security-Bot: SOC2 link: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2 (internal). note: customer-managed KMS supported via key-wrap; open ticket SEC-512 for diagrams. EU-only processing will require private deployment or strict routing.
Finance-Bot: preliminary pricing: 8-GPU reserved pool in eu ~ $Yk/mo at committed utilization; cross-region failover + burst adds ~15-25%. need qps and tokens/day to finalize.
Alex: MerchantCo estimates 60 qps peak, 20 qps avg, ~450M tokens/mo. Ben/Tanner/Priya — actions?
SE-Ben: i'll run a quant vs fp16 diff on a small harness once prompts arrive.
Tanner: i'll prep the structured-output runbook and function-call examples.
Priya: i'll coordinate Legal for KMS diagram and confirm Private vs Dedicated options with Infra.
Alex: thanks. i'll schedule a 30m tech call Wed 9am CET. please drop updates here. :thumbsup:
